description: In-app code-graph UX (deliverables A + C + public export). Add a new 'Graph' modal tab that previews the loaded host-app knowledge graph (structured, grouped-by-type list when non-empty; helpful empty-state with the generate command + load snippet when empty), wire it into the modal as the 8th tab right after 'AI', add a compact empty-graph hint banner to the AI tab's chat path, and export the new tab from the public barrel. All UI follows the existing dark-theme tab conventions. This feature is self-contained TS/TSX and leaves the codebase type-checking; it has no dependency on FEAT-002.
steps: In src/core/AppLensProvider.tsx, widen the exported `TabName` union to include 'Graph', inserting it between 'AI' and 'Settings' so the union reads: 'Overview' | 'Network' | 'Console' | 'Events' | 'Errors' | 'AI' | 'Graph' | 'Settings'.

Create src/tabs/GraphTab.tsx exporting `function GraphTab(): React.JSX.Element`. Read the graph via `AppLens.getKnowledgeGraph()` and compute `const nodes = graph.getNodes();`. EMPTY (nodes.length === 0): render a centered empty-state mirroring AITab's SetupPrompt visual language (reuse the same style ideas: setupContainer/setupTitle/setupBody/setupSectionLabel/codeBlock/codeText). Title: 'No knowledge graph loaded'. Body: 'The knowledge graph is a map of your app\'s screens, components, hooks, services, stores and APIs and how they depend on each other. AppLens AI uses it to answer questions about your architecture, and this tab previews it.' Section label 'Generate it from your app\'s source' above a code block containing exactly `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json`. Section label 'Load it at startup' above a code block containing exactly `import graph from './app-graph.json';\nAppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(graph);`. Footer muted note: 'Point applens-index at your own app\'s source (e.g. ./src), not at AppLens.'. NON-EMPTY: render a ScrollView (container bg #0d0d0d, content padding 12) with: (1) a summary header card showing the total node count and a count-by-type breakdown computed in the fixed order ['screen','component','hook','service','store','api'] (skip types with zero); (2) for each non-empty type (same order) a section header (style: color #888, 11px, fontWeight '700', letterSpacing 0.8, textTransform 'uppercase', marginTop 16, marginBottom 8) followed by a card (#1a1a1a, borderRadius 8) whose rows each show the node name (color #e8e8e8 or accent, fontWeight 600), the file path (muted #888, monospace via fontFamily Platform.OS==='ios'?'Menlo':'monospace'), and when node.dependencies.length>0 a muted line 'uses: ' + node.dependencies.join(', '). Prefer this structured list over dumping toSummary(). Use a local StyleSheet.create in the dark palette (bg #0d0d0d, cards #1a1a1a, accent #00ff88, text #e8e8e8/#ccc, muted #888/#555, borders #2a2a2a/#222).

In src/components/AppLensModal.tsx: import { GraphTab } from '../tabs/GraphTab'; add 'Graph' to the TABS array immediately after 'AI' so it is ['Overview','Network','Console','Events','Errors','AI','Graph','Settings']; add `case 'Graph': return <GraphTab />;` to the TabContent switch (place it after the 'AI' case).

In src/tabs/AITab.tsx: after the existing `if (!provider.isConfigured()) { return <SetupPrompt/> }` early return (so the banner only renders on the configured chat path), compute `const graphEmpty = AppLens.getKnowledgeGraph().getNodes().length === 0;` and, when graphEmpty is true, render a compact non-blocking hint banner as the first child of the returned KeyboardAvoidingView, above the FlatList. Banner: a View (backgroundColor #1a1a1a, borderWidth 1, borderColor #2a2a2a, borderRadius 8, margin 8, padding 10) containing a lead Text (color #00ff88, fontSize 12, fontWeight '600') 'Add a code graph for architecture questions' and a sub Text (color #888, fontSize 11, marginTop 4) 'Run npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json, then AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(require(./app-graph.json)) at startup.' Keep it static (non-dismissible is fine). Do NOT render it when the graph is non-empty and never on the SetupPrompt path. Add the needed styles to the AITab StyleSheet.
In src/index.ts, add `export { GraphTab } from './tabs/GraphTab';` near the other component/tab exports. Keep every existing export unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run type-check` exits 0 (strict), including an exhaustive TabContent switch over the widened TabName union.
src/components/AppLensModal.tsx TABS array has exactly 8 entries in order Overview, Network, Console, Events, Errors, AI, Graph, Settings, and TabContent has a 'Graph' case returning <GraphTab />.

GraphTab renders a structured grouped-by-type list when the graph is non-empty and the specified empty-state (with the exact `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` command and the loadKnowledgeGraph startup snippet) when getNodes().length === 0.
AITab shows the compact empty-graph hint only when provider.isConfigured() is true AND getNodes().length === 0; it is absent when the graph is non-empty and on the unconfigured SetupPrompt path.
GraphTab is exported from src/index.ts and all prior exports remain.
verification: Run `npm run type-check` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 (confirms the new TSX compiles and emits).
Read src/components/AppLensModal.tsx to confirm the 8-tab order and the 'Graph' switch case, and src/tabs/AITab.tsx to confirm the hint is gated behind both isConfigured() and the empty-graph check.
findings: Implemented. For FEAT-002 (docs/packaging): Final modal tab list is exactly 8 tabs in order: Overview, Network, Console, Events, Errors, AI, Graph, Settings (TabName union in src/core/AppLensProvider.tsx widened with 'Graph' between 'AI' and 'Settings'; TABS array + TabContent switch in src/components/AppLensModal.tsx). New public export: `export { GraphTab } from './tabs/GraphTab';` in src/index.ts. Exact generate command used verbatim across GraphTab empty-state and AITab hint: `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json`. GraphTab load snippet (empty-state): `import graph from './app-graph.json';` then `AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(graph);`. GraphTab empty-state copy — title: 'No knowledge graph loaded'; footer note: 'Point applens-index at your own app\'s source (e.g. ./src), not at AppLens.'. AITab empty-graph hint banner (shown only when provider.isConfigured() AND getNodes().length===0) — lead: 'Add a code graph for architecture questions'; sub: 'Run npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json, then AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(require(./app-graph.json)) at startup.'. Graph access API used: AppLens.getKnowledgeGraph().getNodes(); type order ['screen','component','hook','service','store','api']. Verified: `npm run type-check` exit 0, `npm run build` exit 0; dist/ cleaned (not committed). Did NOT touch package.json/docs/CHANGELOG — those belong to FEAT-002. Note: the applens-index CLI bin entry in package.json is FEAT-002's responsibility (the generate command referenced in this UI assumes that bin exists).
